2026-10-31.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

items.text: Renaming of horses and chickens now requires a tool cupboard nearby, preventing unauthorized renames.
Horse canter controls adjusted for smoother movement.
New seagull group spawn points added to deep‑sea monuments, creating dynamic flocks.
Fixed Tier 2 harbors on custom maps to spawn crates correctly.
Turn‑in‑place now respects parent yaw, eliminating odd rotation behavior.
Weapon addon points introduced, allowing new attachment options.
Quick‑craft UI now focusable and navigable with the D‑pad for console players.
Erosion system improved with bug fixes and per‑biome splat maps for more consistent terrain changes.
Store “NEW” notifications now correctly show new skins, and a NullReferenceException crash in the store grid has been resolved.
Streamer mode now correctly hides animal names in all relevant menus.
Crude oil pumped from sphere tanks now counts toward your oil production total.
World generation no longer places floating powerlines over caves; powerlines stay grounded.

2026-10-30.summary:
### Animals & Wildlife
- Renaming of horses and chickens now requires a tool cupboard nearby, preventing unauthorized renames.
- Horse canter controls adjusted for smoother movement.
- New seagull group spawn points added to deep‑sea monuments, creating dynamic flocks.

### Harbor & Loot
- Fixed Tier 2 harbors on custom maps to spawn crates correctly.

### Player Movement
- Turn‑in‑place now respects parent yaw, eliminating odd rotation behavior.

### Weapons & Crafting
- Weapon addon points introduced, allowing new attachment options.
- Quick‑craft UI now focusable and navigable with the D‑pad for console players.

### World & Terrain
- Erosion system improved with bug fixes and per‑biome splat maps for more consistent terrain changes.

### Store & UI
- Store “NEW” notifications now correctly show new skins, and a NullReferenceException crash in the store grid has been resolved.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Streamer mode now correctly hides animal names in all relevant menus.

### Economy
- Crude oil pumped from sphere tanks now counts toward your oil production total.

### World Generation
- World generation no longer places floating powerlines over caves; powerlines stay grounded.

items.text: Fixed full‑height walls where the bottom face could incorrectly connect to the top face of a neighboring wall.
Added a full voxel‑based visibility flood for each base to correctly detect missing sockets and incorrect block connections.
Disabled research and crafting for the UZI 9mm, removing it from the tech tree.
Fixed a sight‑mod bug where ADS values were overridden when the stock was collapsed.
Corrected night‑vision goggle sound restarting when gesturing.
Fixed mortar ammo indicator not updating correctly.
Fixed the loadouts UI delete confirmation popup being uninteractive.
Prevented monument placement where terrain blend maps overlap river topology, stopping floating water glitches.
Various swarm fixes: corrected crab and jellyfish job behavior and made rare blue crab color tints more noticeable.
Fixed beacon repairable collider so it no longer blocks ladders, preventing players from climbing near beacons.
Fixed crow flock error, restoring proper crow behavior.
Server admins can now force gull groups to startle or land via console commands, and gulls no longer clip through obstacles.
Bird interest zones can be placed in monuments to attract flocks; corpses briefly draw crows, and explosions cause birds to flee the area.
Seagull groups have been added to the livestock scene, increasing wildlife activity there.
Bird hit detection bounds have been increased, keeping birds within hit‑registration range and reducing missed shots.

2026-10-29.summary:
### Base Building
- Fixed full‑height walls where the bottom face could incorrectly connect to the top face of a neighboring wall.
- Added a full voxel‑based visibility flood for each base to correctly detect missing sockets and incorrect block connections.

### Weapons & Combat
- Disabled research and crafting for the UZI 9mm, removing it from the tech tree.
- Fixed a sight‑mod bug where ADS values were overridden when the stock was collapsed.
- Corrected night‑vision goggle sound restarting when gesturing.
- Fixed mortar ammo indicator not updating correctly.

### User Interface
- Fixed the loadouts UI delete confirmation popup being uninteractive.

### Map & Environment
- Prevented monument placement where terrain blend maps overlap river topology, stopping floating water glitches.
- Various swarm fixes: corrected crab and jellyfish job behavior and made rare blue crab color tints more noticeable.

### World Interaction & NPC
- Fixed beacon repairable collider so it no longer blocks ladders, preventing players from climbing near beacons.
- Fixed crow flock error, restoring proper crow behavior.

### Wildlife & World
- Server admins can now force gull groups to startle or land via console commands, and gulls no longer clip through obstacles.
- Bird interest zones can be placed in monuments to attract flocks; corpses briefly draw crows, and explosions cause birds to flee the area.
- Seagull groups have been added to the livestock scene, increasing wildlife activity there.
- Bird hit detection bounds have been increased, keeping birds within hit‑registration range and reducing missed shots.
